attr.title: Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories
attr.desc: Native 32-bit ARM port of the Android release of Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories. The original libGTALcs.so engine runs through a custom Android-on-Linux loader providing bionic, NDK and Java-runtime behaviour on top of KMS/DRM, GLES2 and OpenAL. You must supply your own copy of the game - no content is redistributed. The gamepad is read natively by the engine, so no key mapping is used.
attr.inst: Copy your GTA: Liberty City Stories APK and its main.*.com.rockstargames.gtalcs.obb (plus patch.*.obb if you have it) into this port's gtalcs/ folder, then launch. First run shows a setup screen and unpacks both archives, which takes a few minutes; the archives are deleted afterwards. You need about 3.9 GB free during setup and about 2 GB once it is done. Menus are the Android touch frontend: the left stick or D-pad moves a pointer and A taps.
